    • protocolBinding

      public SingleSignOnServiceBuilder protocolBinding(String binding)
      If the SAML holder-of-key profile is used, the Binding attribute should be assigned "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:profiles:holder-of-key:SSO:browser" and the actual binding should be assigned to the hoksso:ProtocolBinding attribute. This method sets the hoksso:ProtocolBinding attribute to the given binding.
      Parameters:
      binding - the binding URI
      Returns:
      this builder
